items.text: “Kolimok idwe luka Isirael ebe, kainut eoŋ ainakinet: ijaunete ainakineteka ŋinituŋanan yenitokotori eketau ainakin,
Na ŋes ainakinet naijaunete; esabu, epuesa, aisinit;
Ka egoe lobululu, ka lomuge, ka Lokareŋan, ka ebaputa loejok, ka ajulo nuka akinei;
Ka imukulen luka imerekekin Iuitereŋitai, ka imukulen luka etakas,
Akinyet naka atala, ka lueuru maa luka akinyet nakinyonyoanakina, ka luka lukisupurununo;
Amor nuemelomeloto, ka amor nuipiripiranara, aibwaikin opod,
Keswamakis eoŋ aiba is nakalaunan; tetere eboie kokidinikec,
Nuketodianakini jo kere, epone loka ewema, ka epone loka iboroke kere, iswamaete yesi kwaŋin.
Ido iswamaete kesi asaduku naka akito nuka sita: aojauke ikubitin
ekubit ŋes aitemis naka aojau bala 1’ 6’.
iarei ka atutubet, alalauke ekubit ediopet ka atutubet, amukururuke ekubit ediopet ka atutubet,
Ido iladaari ŋes kesabu loelai, iladaari kujuke kotomake da, isubakini ŋes atorosit naka esabu airimor.
Itataikini ŋes igilun iwonon luka esabu, kibwaik kes toma akeieke aoŋon; eiaunete igilun iarei kosiepike ediopet, iarei da osiepike ece.
Iswamauni adaketa nuka akito nuka sita, iladaari kes kesabu.
Itolomikini adaketa toma ogilun lukosiepion luka asaduku, adakia ŋes,
Esalanakinete adaketa ogilun luka asaduku: mam elemanario.
Ibwaikini aiteienuner nakainakini jo toma asaduku.
Iswamauni da eicoloŋ-lokaitim loka esabu loclai: aojauke ikubitin iarei ka atutubet, alalauke da ekubit ediopet ka atutubet.
Iswamauni da ikerubin iarei luka esabu; iswamauni kes kaswam naerukuk, kosaijeta iarci luka eicoloŋ-lokaitim.
Iswamakini da ekerubi ediopet osaŋe ediopet, ka ekerubi ece osaŋe ece: iswamakini kwaŋin eicoloŋ-lokaitim ka ikerubin osanetake iarei kobore idiopet.
Igarararete ikerubin abebenokakec kuiu, korapito eicoloŋ-lokaitim kakecebebenoka, kiteos da ireetakec; kosesenete ireeta luka ikerubin eicoloŋ-lokaitim.
Ido ibwaikini eicolon-Iokaitim kuju asaduku; ibwaikini aiteienunet nakainakini jo toma asaduku.
Nen kiriamunun kaio, enerakin kajo koicolon-lokaitim, kokidiŋ kikerubin iarei lueiaas kuju asaduku naka aiteienunet, akiro kere nukainakini kotoma aicorakineta mama ejaas idwe luka Isirael.
Iswamauni emesa da loka akito nuka sita: aojauke ikubitin iarei, alalauke ekubit ediopet, amukururuke da ekubit ediopet ka atutubct.
Iladaari ŋes kesabu loelai, isubakini atorosit naka esabu airimor.
Iswamakini ŋes atokitoit alalau naka akan airimor, iswamakini atorosit naka esabu airimor atokitoit.
Iswamakini ŋes igilun iwonon luka esabu, ibwaikini igilun agoria aoŋon nuejaas akejeke aoŋon,
Idunyakinos igilun katokitoit, araut aiboisio nuka adaketa adakia emesa.
Iswamauni adaketa nuka akito nuka sita, iladaari kes kesabu, adakia emesa.
Iswamauni atubaake, ka akaaleike, ka amotiike, ka atanyake, abukununio; iswamauni kes kesabu loelai.
Ibwaanakini tiritir imugatin luka aitodikin omesa kakonycneka.
Iswamauni epir loka atala kesabu loelai: kaswam naerukuk, ŋes iswamaunia epir loka atala, abwoeteke, ka akodeteke; akolinoke, ka akwesike, ka aturoke, koraas nuka ibore idiopet.
Elomunete da icogen ikanykape kowaitinike; icogen iuni kowai ediopet loka epir loka atala, icogen da iuni kowai loce loka epir laka atala.

Akolin auni nuiswamatai aputorit atur kocoget ediopet, akouke ka aturot; ka akolin auni nuiswamatai aputorit atur kocoget ece, akouke ka aturot: kwaŋin kotoma ocogen ikanykape luelomunito kopir laka atala.
Ejaunete akolin aoŋon kotoma opir laka atala nuiswamatai aputorit atur, ka akwesikec ka aturokec.

Ejaun da akou kwap kicogen iarei luka ibore idiopet, ka akou kwap kicogen iarei luka ibore idiopet, ka akou kwap kicogen iarei luka ibore idiopet, kwapc ejaatar icogen ikanykape luelomunito kopir loka atala,
Akwesikec ka icogenekec koraas luka ibore idiopet: korai kere aswam naerukuk naka esabu loelai.
Iswamauni atalaike akanykaarei: isipokinete da atalaike tetere ccaikinetc,
Eraunos aitudeŋetake ka asaninike nuka ekurwon, nuka esabu loelai.
Iswamauni iboro lu kere kalaniru naka atalata
Koany ebe iswamauni ijo kes kwape ejaar akeceput, nakitodikinitai jo komoru.
